changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Sprint-85 ADR-85-01: rename the asset-map menu entry to 资产概览 so the statistics dashboard is not presented as a navigable map.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET metadata = replace(metadata, '"title":"资产地图"', '"title":"资产概览"'), last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.dataPortalMap' OR metadata LIKE '%"titleKey":"sys.nav.portal.dataPortalMap"%' OR metadata LIKE '%"title":"资产地图"%' );
